title: Common refinement Frobenius cube components
statement: Fix D,C,E,n,hn and S:SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn as in [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. At the common coefficient stage let L be the Frobenius comparisons satisfying the corresponding normalization of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]. For the canonical change between two arbitrary geometric compactifications, allowing distinct model compactification anchors, the component cube equation c_F(K) α(P_in K)=P_out(α(K)) c_G(K) holds for every object K. Here the iterated comparisons and the actual transformations are precisely those of [def-pod-semilinear-exchange-cube-data]; use all separatedness, finite-type, finite-Tor, lattice and witnessed-origin restrictions specified there. This assertion is only the refinement underlying-category part, without fixed-pair equations or the representative-change intertwining conclusions.

proof.text:
Base change a common refinement of the two indexed model compactifications
along Frobenius, and twist its source k-structure. The underlying proper/open sites
and maps are unchanged. Clause (4) of fix-lem-exchanges makes the canonical refinement
comparison commute with the Frobenius exchange. Transport from the two model anchors
to the displayed geometric representatives by their normalization formulas. The
comparison cocycle cancels the intervening maps. Rationalization and common-stage
passage preserve this equality, using one finite field for its finite diagram.
This compares distinct model anchors as a conclusion, without assuming their agreement.
